definitions.n_images_all_measured: all measured rows per species; no outcome/classifiability filtering
definitions.n_observers_all_measured: distinct non-empty observer_id among all measured rows per species
definitions.maximum_span_km_all_measured: exact maximum pairwise haversine great-circle distance among all finite latitude/longitude rows, Earth radius 6371.0088 km

frozen_sensitivity_model.reason_n_images_not_fitted: n_images_all_measured is exactly 100 for every species in both cohorts and has zero variance by design
frozen_sensitivity_model.transformation: rank each variable within cohort; regress centered rank(D) on intercept plus centered ranks of log1p(n_classifiable), log1p(n_observers_all_measured), and log1p(maximum_span_km_all_measured); use residual as sensitivity trait
frozen_sensitivity_model.selection_rule: controls fixed from the pre-outcome audit; no control can be added, removed, or selected using D associations

hard_rule: H3a signal analysis must download this exact artifact, verify panel SHA256 and measured-file SHA256 values, and use the frozen sensitivity model without outcome-driven covariate selection.
